policy.headline: Hosted model calls are the only thing that costs money per game. Everything else runs on a laptop we already own.
policy.rule: The router refuses to exceed the cap. Every request is cached by content hash, so re-running a game never re-bills for unchanged work. Actual usage from every response is logged and replaces the estimates below.
policy.starting_policy: Triggers only: send frames to the hosted model only when the local models signal trouble (piles, contested catches, lost ball, lost identity, failed field registration).

assumptions: Estimates at Anthropic list prices as of 2026-09-11. One request is about 8 frames downscaled to about 1000 by 1000 pixels (about 1,300 tokens each) plus a short structured answer. Roughly 180 plays per game.

scenarios.name: Triggers only, about 15% of plays fire
Every play, both angles, plus jersey contact sheets

fixed.note: Already owned. No cloud GPU rented so far.
Owner's existing subscription; not billed to the project.

future_options.item: Rented cloud GPU for training runs
future_options.when: If SAM 3 teacher passes or detector training take longer than a night on the laptop.
Only if a comparison on the same frames shows a clear accuracy gain.
